description: Google publishes spend and impression ranges only for election ads; commercial advertisers omit both. isActive is true when lastShown is within 7 UTC days. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

advertiser.description: Advertiser name, domain (e.g. nike.com), or Google advertiser ID (AR…). Prefer AR… from advertiser-search.

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country / region code (soft filter). Default US. Alias: region. Non-ISO codes are a definitive 400 INVALID_COUNTRY.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — keep creatives whose shown window overlaps this end.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Flat 2 credits when results are returned; 0 credits when totalReturned is 0.

sort.description: Client-side sort: last_shown (recent activity first) or first_shown. Default is ATC order.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — keep creatives whose shown window overlaps this start.

topic.description: Only "all" is supported (commercial ATC). Google publishes spend and impression ranges only for election ads; commercial advertisers omit both. isActive is true when lastShown is within 7 UTC days.

name: google_ad_library_company_ads
